description: Compute as a market, no key: the on-demand hourly price of each data-centre GPU (B200, H200, H100, A100, L40S...) across the clouds and GPU marketplaces, the cheapest, median and dearest offer with who offers it, every provider's offer for one model, recent list-price changes, and the Cirrun GPU Index (a daily chained index of those prices). Each price is the provider's own list price with the date it was confirmed.

changes.description: Latest list-price changes to return; default 20.

gpu.description: A GPU model (H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX 4090...): every provider's offer for it. Default: one row per model.

provider.description: Only this provider's offers, e.g. RunPod or AWS.

name: compute_prices

outputSchema.description: Without gpu, rows are GPU models with their cheapest, median and dearest offers; with gpu, rows are every provider's offer for it, cheapest first. Prices are USD per GPU-hour.

title: GPU compute prices (Cirrun index)
